events.text: The Peace of Westphalia is signed, ending the Thirty Years' War.
The first transcontinental telegraph line across the United States is completed.
Annie Edson Taylor becomes the first person to go over Niagara Falls in a barrel.
Black Thursday: the Wall Street Crash begins.
The United Nations Charter enters into force.
A camera on a V-2 rocket takes the first photograph of Earth from space.
Zambia gains independence from the United Kingdom.
Concorde makes its last commercial flight.
